lessons.title: Strict Typing & Generics
overview: Deep dive into TypeScript strict mode, utility types, and generic constraints for enterprise application development.
Construct type-safe data transformations and avoid unsafe type assertions in production.

takeaways.title: Exhaustive Pattern Matching
takeaways.desc: Use discriminated unions to enforce handling of all component states at compile time.

takeaways.title: Generic Constraints
takeaways.desc: Limit polymorphic types using extends to prevent unintended runtime failures.

lessons.title: Asynchronous JS & Promises
overview: Master the event loop, microtask queuing, and concurrency primitives in modern JavaScript runtimes.
Implement robust error recovery mechanisms and abortable fetch operations.

takeaways.title: AbortController Primitives
takeaways.desc: Cancel inflight requests to prevent memory leaks and race condition states.

takeaways.title: Parallel vs Sequential Flows
takeaways.desc: Use Promise.allSettled for resilient non-blocking multi-resource hydrations.

lessons.title: TS Architecture in Scale
overview: Structure monorepo-ready folder topologies, path aliases, and shared schema contracts between client and server.
Establish strict type boundaries using runtime validation with Zod.

takeaways.title: Schema First Validation
takeaways.desc: Derive TypeScript interfaces directly from Zod schemas to ensure single-source truth.

takeaways.title: Decoupled Domain Types
takeaways.desc: Isolate presentation layer types from raw backend network payload models.
